hint: sending an object back to its country of origin
example: The repatriation of looted artefacts remains controversial.
exampleTranslation: Возвращение награбленных артефактов остаётся спорным вопросом.

hint: giving back something that was taken
example: The debate over restitution is far from over.
exampleTranslation: Спор о реституции далёк от завершения.

hint: the origin and ownership history of an object
example: The provenance of the vase is disputed.

hint: something left by the past that still affects the present
example: The legacy of colonialism is still debated today.
exampleTranslation: Наследие колониализма обсуждается до сих пор.

hint: control of other countries by a stronger power
example: Many museum collections are linked to colonialism.
exampleTranslation: Многие музейные коллекции связаны с колониализмом.
